question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The company plans __to expand__ its business to the international market.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"expand"** means to increase in size, number, or importance. (विस्तार करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The university plans** to expand** its campus facilities over the next five years.
 
 
 
• **"Increase"** refers to becoming or making something greater in size, amount, or degree. (बढ़ाना)
 
 
• **Example:** The company aims **to increase** its market share by 15% next year.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that** "expand" and "increase" **are closely related in the context of growing or enlarging something.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: to reduce** (कम करना): To make something smaller or less in size, amount, or degree.

 
 
• **Example:** The company decided **to reduce** its workforce to cut costs.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: to contract** (सिकुड़ना): To decrease in size, number, or range.
 
 
• **Example:** The economy is expected** to contract **by 2% this year.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: to limit** (सीमित करना): To set a boundary or cap on the size, amount, or extent of something.
 
 
• **Example:** The new policy will** limit** the number of visitors allowed in the park at one time.
 
 

39:Tbf8,

The correct answer is **Option 3)**
